subject: Demo recap + evaluation roadmap and kickoff proposal — HarborView Health
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Kline <lena.kline@harborviewhealth.com>, Tom Anders <t.anders@harborviewhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jul 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + evaluation roadmap and kickoff proposal — HarborView Health

Hi Lena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time to walk through the demo yesterday. Quick recap and a proposed evaluation roadmap so we can move to a short trial that validates the key success criteria we discussed. I attached a concise POC outline and our evaluation checklist for your team.

High-level goals (proposed):
- Validate retrieval + LLM responses on clinical triage workflows (sample anonymized transcripts)
- Maintain p95 latency under 250ms for 512-token generation in the "fast" model path
- Achieve classification F1 >= 0.88 for triage labels on the sample set
- Confirm secure handling of PHI (KMS, audit logs) and acceptable residual risk for HarborView SecOps

Proposed trial scope and timeline:
- Duration: 4 weeks (config + run 2 weeks, evaluation 2 weeks)
- Start: target week of Jul 20; kickoff meeting suggested Jul 22 at 10:00am PT (proposed below)
- Test bed: subset of 5k anonymized transcripts + synthetic augmentations (we'll share ingestion instructions)
- Variants: 1) Fast low-latency model (quantized), 2) Higher-accuracy model (float16) for quality comparison

Ownership (proposed):
- Sales lead / commercial: Aditya Rao (me) — SOW/contract, scheduling, acceptance criteria sign-off
- Technical lead: Marissa Cole — deployment configuration, eval script, monitoring hooks
- Infrastructure / private deploy liaison: Karthik Iyer — VPC/KMS details and any on-prem questions

Immediate asks for HarborView to confirm:
1) Confirm success metrics above or share alternate thresholds (latency, F1, embedding similarity).
2) Confirm security contact for SOC2/KMS questions (we'll need a short intake form).
3) Permission to provision a small reserved staging pool for the trial (cost estimate in the attached outline).

Attachments: harborview_poc_outline.pdf (POC plan), redwood_eval_checklist.xlsx (evaluation tasks), trial_contract_docusign_link.txt

If the goals look reasonable I'll send a short kickoff calendar invite for Jul 22 and Marissa will follow up with the technical runbook for data ingestion.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference for production LLMs

From: Lena Kline <lena.kline@harborviewhealth.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Anders <t.anders@harborviewhealth.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + evaluation roadmap and kickoff proposal — HarborView Health

Thanks, Aditya — good summary and appreciate the attachments. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates: 

1) PHI / compliance — Our security team needs SOC2 Type II and confirmation that Redwood can integrate with our KMS or provide a bring-your-own-key option. Can you send the SOC2 report and an architecture note on KMS support?

2) Trial length and cost — We like the 4-week plan. Can you provide a maximum cost estimate for the trial (we prefer a not-to-exceed number) and confirm whether Redwood can cap spend at $5k for the initial run?

3) Success metrics — The suggested targets look sensible. For classification F1, can you confirm how you’ll measure at the per-patient level vs per-message level? We prefer patient-level aggregates.

4) Stakeholders — Please include our security contact in thread: Priya Desai (cc'd in a follow-up). She will own the compliance intake.

Assuming SOC2 and KMS options look good, Jul 22 kickoff should be fine. Could you also share a short runbook for anonymization requirements so our data team can start prepping?

Lena Kline
Director, Innovation Programs | HarborView Health
lena.kline@harborviewhealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Kline <lena.kline@harborviewhealth.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + evaluation roadmap and kickoff proposal — HarborView Health

Thanks Lena — looping in a quick technical confirmation and next steps.

On Sun, Jul 12, 2026 at 09:14 AM Lena Kline <lena.kline@harborviewhealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks, Aditya — good summary and appreciate the attachments. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock dates:
>
> 1) PHI / compliance — Our security team needs SOC2 Type II and confirmation that Redwood can integrate with our KMS or provide a bring-your-own-key option.

We can provide SOC2 Type II and a brief architecture note; attaching a link in HubSpot and the SOC2 redacted bundle in the Drive folder. For KMS: we support both Redwood-managed KMS and customer-managed keys via our KMS integrations (AWS KMS & GCP KMS). We'll map the key lifecycle steps in the short architecture note.

Technical POC proposal (concise):
- Data: HarborView provides an anonymized export (5k transcripts). We'll provide an anonymization checklist — minimum fields and hashing approach.
- Evaluation harness: We'll run an automated evaluation that produces per-patient and per-message metrics; we will report patient-aggregated F1 as requested.
- Performance: Target p95 inference latency < 250ms for the fast model path at 512 tokens with a sustained concurrency of 10 req/s.
- Quality: Target patient-level F1 >= 0.88; embedding similarity target mean cosine >= 0.85 for retrieval tasks.
- Observability: We'll expose token-level cost, request traces, and per-route latency on the Redwood Console for your SecOps team.

Ownership and timeline (technical):
- Marissa Cole — POC technical lead (test harness, dashboards, eval scripts).
- Karthik Iyer — infra and VPC/KMS setup (will run checklist with Priya).
- Aditya Rao — commercial / acceptance criteria sign-off.

Next immediate items we will deliver (by Jul 15):
1) SOC2 redacted bundle + short KMS architecture note (Marissa).
2) Anonymization runbook and ingestion template (Marissa).
3) Cost estimate for the proposed staging resources and a spend cap option (Aditya).
4) Draft DocuSign trial contract with a $5k cap option included for HarborView review (Aditya).

I attached the evaluation checklist (redwood_eval_checklist.xlsx) and a one-page POC outline (harborview_poc_outline.pdf) for easy review. If Priya is happy with the KMS approach we can provision a staging VPC and lock a kickoff for Jul 22.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

From: Tom Anders <t.anders@harborviewhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap + evaluation roadmap and kickoff proposal — HarborView Health

Aditya / Marissa —

Appreciate the clear plan. Two quick items from my side:

1) Security contact — Priya Desai (Priya.Desai@harborviewhealth.com) will join the thread shortly and run the intake. We'll need SOC2, KMS notes, and a short E2E runbook for review.

2) Budget — We are prepared to run the 4-week trial with a hard not-to-exceed of $5,000 for the initial run. Please include a cap in the trial contract.

If the SOC2/KMS answers are satisfactory we can confirm Jul 22 kickoff at 10:00am PT. Please send a 30-min invite and include a short agenda: introductions, security checkpoints, data handoff plan, and next 7-day milestones.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Tom Anders
